question: Not moving Inventory since last 1 year
query:
WITH base_data AS (
 SELECT
 tv.guid,
 tv.date,
 tv.voucher_number,
 tv.voucher_type,
 tv.party_name,
 ml.name AS ledger_name,
 mg.name AS ledger_group,
 ta.amount
 FROM trn_voucher tv
 JOIN trn_accounting ta ON tv.guid = ta.guid
 JOIN mst_ledger ml ON ta._ledger = ml.guid
 JOIN mst_group mg ON ml._parent = mg.guid
 WHERE
 tv.is_order_voucher = 0
 AND LOWER(tv.voucher_type) LIKE '%sales%'
 AND tv.date BETWEEN '2022-04-01' AND '2023-03-31'
),
inventory_data AS (
 SELECT
 ti.guid,
 si.name AS item_name,
 ABS(ti.quantity) AS quantity,
 ABS(ti.rate) AS rate,
 ABS(ti.amount) AS item_value
 FROM trn_inventory ti
 JOIN mst_stock_item si ON ti._item = si.guid
 WHERE ti.quantity < 0 -- Outward movement for sales
),
tax_data AS (
 SELECT
 guid,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%outputcgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%cgst%'
 THEN ABS(amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS cgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%outputsgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%sgst%'
 THEN ABS(amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS sgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%outputigst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%igst%'
 THEN ABS(amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS igst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(ledger_name) LIKE '%discount%'
 OR LOWER(ledger_name) LIKE '%rebate%'
 OR LOWER(ledger_name) LIKE '%scheme%'
 THEN ABS(amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS discount
 FROM base_data
 GROUP BY guid
)
SELECT
 tv.date,
 tv.voucher_number,
 tv.voucher_type,
 tv.party_name,
 i.item_name,
 i.quantity,
 i.rate,
 i.item_value AS taxable_value,
 t.discount,
 t.cgst,
 t.sgst,
 t.igst,
 (t.cgst + t.sgst + t.igst) AS total_gst,
 (i.item_value + t.cgst + t.sgst + t.igst) AS invoice_total
FROM trn_voucher tv
JOIN inventory_data i ON tv.guid = i.guid
LEFT JOIN tax_data t ON tv.guid = t.guid
WHERE
 LOWER(tv.voucher_type) LIKE '%sales%'
 AND tv.date BETWEEN '2020-04-01' AND '2020-04-30'
ORDER BY
 tv.date,
 tv.voucher_number,
 i.item_name;

question: What is the balance in the Cash ledger?
query: SELECT ml.name AS ledger_name, SUM(CASE WHEN ta.amount < 0 THEN ABS(ta.amount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_debit, SUM(CASE WHEN ta.amount > 0 THEN ta.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, SUM(ta.amount) AS net_amount FROM mst_ledger ml LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.ledger, ta.amount FROM trn_accounting ta JOIN trn_voucher tv ON ta.guid = tv.guid WHERE (tv.is_order_voucher = 0) AND (tv.is_inventory_voucher = 0) AND tv.date >= '2020-05-01' AND tv.date <= '2020-05-31' ) ta ON ml.name = ta.ledger WHERE ml.parent = 'Indirect Expenses' GROUP BY ml.name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ta.amount < 0 THEN ABS(ta.amount) ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN ta.amount > 0 THEN ta.amount ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY total_debit DESC;

question: How much do we owe to creditors?
query: WITH monthly_cash AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tv.date) as year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM tv.date) as month, TO_CHAR(tv.date, 'Month') as month_name, SUM(ta.amount) as net_amount FROM trn_accounting ta JOIN trn_voucher tv ON ta.guid = tv.guid JOIN mst_ledger ml ON ta.ledger = ml.name WHERE (tv.is_order_voucher = 0) AND (tv.is_inventory_voucher = 0) AND ml.name = 'Cash' AND tv.date BETWEEN '2020-04-01' AND '2021-03-31' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tv.date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM tv.date), TO_CHAR(tv.date, 'Month')), opening_balance AS (SELECT opening_balance as cash_opening FROM mst_ledger WHERE name = 'Cash') SELECT month_name, year, month, net_amount, (SELECT cash_opening FROM opening_balance) + SUM(net_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year, month ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as closing_balance FROM monthly_cash ORDER BY year, month;

question: Who are our debtors and how much do they owe?
query: SELECT ml.name as creditor_name, ml.opening_balance, COALESCE(trans.net_amount, 0) as net_transactions, (ml.opening_balance + COALESCE(trans.net_amount, 0)) as outstanding_amount FROM mst_ledger ml LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.ledger, SUM(ta.amount) as net_amount FROM trn_accounting ta JOIN trn_voucher tv ON ta.guid = tv.guid WHERE (tv.is_order_voucher = 0) AND (tv.is_inventory_voucher = 0) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tv.date) = 2021 GROUP BY ta.ledger ) trans ON ml.name = trans.ledger WHERE ml.parent = 'Sundry Creditors' AND (ml.opening_balance + COALESCE(trans.net_amount, 0)) != 0 ORDER BY outstanding_amount DESC;

question: Show me all journal entries made yesterday.
query:
WITH base_data AS (
 SELECT
 tv.guid,
 tv.date,
 tv.voucher_number,
 tv.voucher_type,
 tv.party_name,
 ml.name AS ledger_name,
 mg.name AS ledger_group,
 ta.amount
 FROM trn_voucher tv
 JOIN trn_accounting ta ON tv.guid = ta.guid
 JOIN mst_ledger ml ON ta._ledger = ml.guid
 JOIN mst_group mg ON ml._parent = mg.guid
 WHERE
 tv.is_order_voucher = 0
 AND tv.is_inventory_voucher = 0
 AND LOWER(tv.voucher_type) LIKE '%purchase%'
 AND tv.date BETWEEN '2020-05-01' AND '2020-05-31'
),
inventory_data AS (
 SELECT
 guid,
 SUM(ABS(quantity)) AS total_quantity
 FROM trn_inventory
 WHERE quantity > 0
 GROUP BY guid
),
aggregated_data AS (
 SELECT
 b.date,
 b.voucher_number,
 b.voucher_type,
 b.party_name,
 b.guid,
 /* Taxable Value */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN b.ledger_group IN ('Purchase Accounts')
 THEN ABS(b.amount) ELSE 0 END
 ) AS taxable_value,
 /* Discounts */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%discount%'
 OR LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%incentive%'
 OR LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%margin%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount) ELSE 0 END
 ) AS total_discount,
 /* GST */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%inputcgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%cgst%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS cgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%inputsgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%sgst%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS sgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%inputigst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name,' ','')) LIKE '%igst%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS igst,
 COALESCE(MAX(i.total_quantity),0) AS total_quantity
 FROM base_data b
 LEFT JOIN inventory_data i ON b.guid = i.guid
 GROUP BY
 b.date,
 b.voucher_number,
 b.voucher_type,
 b.party_name,
 b.guid
)
SELECT
 date,
 voucher_number,
 voucher_type,
 party_name,
 total_quantity,
 (taxable_value + total_discount) AS gross_purchase_value,
 total_discount,
 taxable_value,
 cgst,
 sgst,
 igst,
 (cgst + sgst + igst) AS total_gst,
 (taxable_value + cgst + sgst + igst) AS invoice_total
FROM aggregated_data
ORDER BY date, voucher_number;

question: What is the total outstanding receivable
query:
WITH base_data AS (
 SELECT
 tv.guid,
 tv.date,
 tv.voucher_number,
 tv.voucher_type,
 ml.name AS ledger_name,
 mg.name AS ledger_group,
 ta.amount
 FROM trn_voucher tv
 JOIN trn_accounting ta ON tv.guid = ta.guid
 JOIN mst_ledger ml ON ta._ledger = ml.guid
 JOIN mst_group mg ON ml._parent = mg.guid
 WHERE
 tv.is_order_voucher = 0
 AND tv.is_inventory_voucher = 0
 AND LOWER(tv.voucher_type) LIKE '%purchase%'
),
inventory_data AS (
 SELECT
 guid,
 SUM(ABS(quantity)) AS total_quantity
 FROM trn_inventory
 WHERE quantity > 0 -- Inward for purchases
 GROUP BY guid
),
aggregated_data AS (
 SELECT
 DATE_TRUNC('month', b.date) AS month,
 TO_CHAR(b.date, 'Month YYYY') AS month_name,
 b.guid,
 /* Taxable Value - Purchase Accounts */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN b.ledger_group IN ('Purchase Accounts')
 THEN ABS(b.amount) ELSE 0 END
 ) AS taxable_value,
 /* Discounts */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%discount%'
 OR LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%incentive%'
 OR LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%margin%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount) ELSE 0 END
 ) AS total_discount,
 /* GST Breakup - Input GST for purchases */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%inputcgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%cgst%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS cgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%inputsgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%sgst%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS sgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%inputigst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%igst%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS igst,
 /* Quantity */
 COALESCE(MAX(i.total_quantity), 0) AS total_quantity
 FROM base_data b
 LEFT JOIN inventory_data i ON b.guid = i.guid
 GROUP BY
 DATE_TRUNC('month', b.date),
 TO_CHAR(b.date, 'Month YYYY'),
 b.guid
)
SELECT
 month_name,
 COUNT(DISTINCT guid) AS total_invoices,
 SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity,
 SUM(taxable_value + total_discount) AS gross_purchase_value,
 SUM(total_discount) AS total_discount,
 SUM(taxable_value) AS taxable_value,
 SUM(cgst) AS cgst,
 SUM(sgst) AS sgst,
 SUM(igst) AS igst,
 SUM(cgst + sgst + igst) AS total_gst,
 SUM(taxable_value + cgst + sgst + igst) AS invoice_total
FROM aggregated_data
GROUP BY
 month,
 month_name
ORDER BY
 month;

 OR LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%margin%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount) ELSE 0 END
 ) AS total_discount,
 /* GST Breakup */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%outputcgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%cgst%'
 THEN b.amount
 ELSE 0
 END) AS cgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%outputsgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%sgst%'
 THEN b.amount
 ELSE 0
 END) AS sgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%outputigst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%igst%'
 THEN b.amount
 ELSE 0
 END) AS igst,
 /* Quantity */
 COALESCE(MAX(i.total_quantity), 0) AS total_quantity
 FROM base_data b
 LEFT JOIN inventory_data i ON b.guid = i.guid
 GROUP BY
 b.date,
 b.voucher_number,
 b.voucher_type,
 b.guid
)
SELECT

 voucher_number,
 voucher_type,
 total_quantity,
 (taxable_value + total_discount) AS gross_sales_value,
 total_discount,
 taxable_value,
 cgst,
 sgst,
 igst,
 (cgst + sgst + igst) AS total_gst,
 (taxable_value + cgst + sgst + igst) AS invoice_total
FROM aggregated_data
ORDER BY
 invoice_total DESC
LIMIT 5;

	group by i.item, i.tracking_number

question: Show me the Trial Balance for March.
query:
declare
 @fromDate date = '2020-04-01',
 @toDate date = '2021-03-31';
with tblop as
(
 select a.ledger 'ledger', sum(a.amount) 'amount'
 from trn_accounting a
 join trn_voucher v on v.guid = a.guid
 where v.is_order_voucher = 0 and v.is_inventory_voucher = 0 and v.date < @fromDate
 group by a.ledger
),
tblcurr as
(
 select a.ledger 'ledger',
 sum(case when a.amount < 0 then abs(a.amount) else 0 end) 'debit',
 sum(case when a.amount > 0 then a.amount else 0 end) 'credit'
 from trn_accounting a
 join trn_voucher v on v.guid = a.guid
 where v.is_order_voucher = 0 and v.is_inventory_voucher = 0 and v.date between @fromDate and @toDate
 group by a.ledger
)
select l.name,
(case when l.is_revenue = 0 then (l.opening_balance + isnull(op.amount,0)) else 0 end) 'opening',
isnull(curr.debit,0) 'debit',
isnull(curr.credit,0) 'credit',
(case when l.is_revenue = 0 then (l.opening_balance + isnull(op.amount,0)) + isnull(curr.credit,0) - isnull(curr.debit,0) else isnull(curr.credit,0) - isnull(curr.debit,0) end) 'closing'
from mst_ledger l
left join tblop op on op.ledger = l.name
left join tblcurr curr on curr.ledger = l.name
order by l.name
;

question: What decisions should I take today?
query:
WITH base_data AS (
 SELECT
 tv.guid,
 tv.date,
 tv.voucher_number,
 tv.voucher_type,
 ml.name AS ledger_name,
 mg.name AS ledger_group,
 ta.amount
 FROM trn_voucher tv
 JOIN trn_accounting ta ON tv.guid = ta.guid
 JOIN mst_ledger ml ON ta._ledger = ml.guid
 JOIN mst_group mg ON ml._parent = mg.guid
 WHERE
 tv.is_order_voucher = 0
 AND tv.is_inventory_voucher = 0
 AND LOWER(tv.voucher_type) LIKE '%sales%'
),
inventory_data AS (
 SELECT
 guid,
 SUM(ABS(quantity)) AS total_quantity
 FROM trn_inventory
 WHERE quantity < 0
 GROUP BY guid
),
aggregated_data AS (
 SELECT
 DATE_TRUNC('month', b.date) AS month,
 TO_CHAR(b.date, 'Month YYYY') AS month_name,
 b.guid,
 /* Taxable Value */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN b.ledger_group IN ('Sales Accounts')
 THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END
 ) AS taxable_value,
 /* Discounts */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%discount%'
 OR LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%incentive%'
 OR LOWER(b.ledger_name) LIKE '%margin%'
 THEN ABS(b.amount) ELSE 0 END
 ) AS total_discount,
 /* GST Breakup */
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%outputcgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%cgst%'
 THEN b.amount
 ELSE 0
 END) AS cgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%outputsgst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%sgst%'
 THEN b.amount
 ELSE 0
 END) AS sgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%outputigst%'
 OR LOWER(REPLACE(b.ledger_name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%igst%'
 THEN b.amount
 ELSE 0
 END) AS igst,
 /* Quantity */
 COALESCE(MAX(i.total_quantity), 0) AS total_quantity
 FROM base_data b
 LEFT JOIN inventory_data i ON b.guid = i.guid
 GROUP BY
 DATE_TRUNC('month', b.date),
 TO_CHAR(b.date, 'Month YYYY'),
 b.guid
)
SELECT
 month_name,
 COUNT(DISTINCT guid) AS total_invoices,
 SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity,
 SUM(taxable_value + total_discount) AS gross_sales_value,
 SUM(total_discount) AS total_discount,
 SUM(taxable_value) AS taxable_value,
 SUM(cgst) AS cgst,
 SUM(sgst) AS sgst,
 SUM(igst) AS igst,
 SUM(cgst + sgst + igst) AS total_gst,
 SUM(taxable_value + cgst + sgst + igst) AS invoice_total
FROM aggregated_data
GROUP BY
 month,
 month_name
ORDER BY
 month;

)

question: Any duplicate entries today?
query:
SELECT
 TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
 TO_CHAR(v.date, 'Month YYYY') AS month_name,
 ABS(SUM(a.amount)) AS sales_amount,
 LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date)) AS previous_month_sales,
 CASE
 WHEN LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date)) > 0
 THEN ROUND(
 ((ABS(SUM(a.amount)) - LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date)))
 / LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date))) * 100,
 2
 )
 ELSE 0
 END AS percentage_change,
 CASE
 WHEN LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date)) > 0
 AND ((ABS(SUM(a.amount)) - LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date)))
 / LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date))) < -0.20
 THEN 'Abnormal Drop (>20%)'
 WHEN LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date)) > 0
 AND ((ABS(SUM(a.amount)) - LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date)))
 / LAG(ABS(SUM(a.amount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date))) < 0
 THEN 'Decline'
 ELSE 'Normal/Growth'
 END AS trend_flag
FROM trn_voucher v
INNER JOIN trn_accounting a ON v.guid = a.guid
INNER JOIN mst_vouchertype vt ON v._voucher_type = vt.guid
INNER JOIN mst_ledger l ON a._ledger = l.guid
INNER JOIN mst_group g ON l._parent = g.guid
WHERE v.date BETWEEN '2020-04-01' AND '2021-03-31'
 AND v.is_order_voucher = 0
 AND v.is_inventory_voucher = 0

question: What is total TDS deducted?
query:
WITH gstr1_summary AS (
 SELECT
 DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date) AS month,
 -- ✅ Taxable (ONLY sales accounts)
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'sales accounts'
 AND vt.parent IN ('Sales','Debit Note')
 THEN ABS(a.amount)
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'sales accounts'
 AND vt.parent = 'Credit Note'
 THEN -ABS(a.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS gstr1_taxable_value,
 -- ✅ CGST
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'duties & taxes'
 AND LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%cgst%'
 AND vt.parent IN ('Sales','Debit Note')
 THEN ABS(a.amount)
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'duties & taxes'
 AND LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%cgst%'
 AND vt.parent = 'Credit Note'
 THEN -ABS(a.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS gstr1_cgst,
 -- ✅ SGST
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'duties & taxes'
 AND LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%sgst%'
 AND vt.parent IN ('Sales','Debit Note')
 THEN ABS(a.amount)
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'duties & taxes'
 AND LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%sgst%'
 AND vt.parent = 'Credit Note'
 THEN -ABS(a.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS gstr1_sgst,
 -- ✅ IGST
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'duties & taxes'
 AND LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%igst%'
 AND vt.parent IN ('Sales','Debit Note')
 THEN ABS(a.amount)
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'duties & taxes'
 AND LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%igst%'
 AND vt.parent = 'Credit Note'
 THEN -ABS(a.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END) AS gstr1_igst
 FROM trn_voucher v
 JOIN mst_vouchertype vt ON v._voucher_type = vt.guid
 JOIN trn_accounting a ON v.guid = a.guid
 JOIN mst_ledger l ON a._ledger = l.guid
 JOIN mst_group g ON l._parent = g.guid
 WHERE
 v.date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'
 AND v.is_order_voucher = 0
 AND v.is_inventory_voucher = 0
 AND vt.parent IN ('Sales', 'Credit Note', 'Debit Note')
 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date)
),
gstr3b_summary AS (
 SELECT
 DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date) AS month,
 -- ✅ ONLY outward GST (3.1a)
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'duties & taxes'
 AND LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%cgst%'
 AND vt.parent IN ('Sales','Debit Note','Credit Note')
 THEN ABS(a.amount) ELSE 0
 END) AS gstr3b_cgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'duties & taxes'
 AND LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%sgst%'
 AND vt.parent IN ('Sales','Debit Note','Credit Note')
 THEN ABS(a.amount) ELSE 0
 END) AS gstr3b_sgst,
 SUM(CASE
 WHEN LOWER(g.primary_group) = 'duties & taxes'
 AND LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%igst%'
 AND vt.parent IN ('Sales','Debit Note','Credit Note')
 THEN ABS(a.amount) ELSE 0
 END) AS gstr3b_igst
 FROM trn_voucher v
 JOIN mst_vouchertype vt ON v._voucher_type = vt.guid
 JOIN trn_accounting a ON v.guid = a.guid
 JOIN mst_ledger l ON a._ledger = l.guid
 JOIN mst_group g ON l._parent = g.guid
 WHERE
 v.date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'
 AND v.is_order_voucher = 0
 AND vt.parent IN ('Sales','Debit Note','Credit Note')
 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', v.date)
)
SELECT
 TO_CHAR(g1.month, 'Mon-YYYY') AS month,
 ROUND(g1.gstr1_taxable_value, 2) AS gstr1_taxable_value,
 ROUND(g1.gstr1_cgst, 2) AS gstr1_cgst,
 ROUND(g1.gstr1_sgst, 2) AS gstr1_sgst,
 ROUND(g1.gstr1_igst, 2) AS gstr1_igst,
 ROUND(g3.gstr3b_cgst, 2) AS gstr3b_cgst,
 ROUND(g3.gstr3b_sgst, 2) AS gstr3b_sgst,
 ROUND(g3.gstr3b_igst, 2) AS gstr3b_igst,
 -- ✅ Difference
 ROUND(g1.gstr1_cgst - g3.gstr3b_cgst, 2) AS cgst_mismatch,
 ROUND(g1.gstr1_sgst - g3.gstr3b_sgst, 2) AS sgst_mismatch,
 ROUND(g1.gstr1_igst - g3.gstr3b_igst, 2) AS igst_mismatch,
 CASE
 WHEN ABS(g1.gstr1_cgst - g3.gstr3b_cgst) > 1
 OR ABS(g1.gstr1_sgst - g3.gstr3b_sgst) > 1
 OR ABS(g1.gstr1_igst - g3.gstr3b_igst) > 1
 THEN 'Mismatch Found'
 ELSE 'Match'
 END AS status
FROM gstr1_summary g1
JOIN gstr3b_summary g3
 ON g1.month = g3.month;

)

 ELSE 0

query: SELECT v.date, v.voucher_type, v.voucher_number, v.party_name, l.name AS ledger_name, CASE WHEN a.amount < 0 THEN ABS(a.amount) ELSE 0 END AS debit_amount, CASE WHEN a.amount > 0 THEN ABS(a.amount) ELSE 0 END AS credit_amount FROM trn_voucher v INNER JOIN trn_accounting a ON v.guid = a.guid INNER JOIN mst_ledger l ON a._ledger = l.guid INNER JOIN mst_group g ON l._parent = g.guid INNER JOIN mst_vouchertype vt ON v._voucher_type = vt.guid WHERE vt.parent = 'Payment' AND v.is_accounting_voucher = 1 AND v.is_order_voucher = 0 AND v.is_inventory_voucher = 0 AND v.date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-01' AND v.guid NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a2.guid FROM trn_accounting a2 INNER JOIN mst_ledger l2 ON a2._ledger = l2.guid INNER JOIN mst_group g2 ON l2._parent = g2.guid WHERE g2.primary_group = 'Duties & Taxes' AND (l2.name ILIKE '%TDS%' OR l2.parent ILIKE '%TDS%') ) ORDER BY v.date DESC, v.voucher_number;

question: Any round-off manipulation?
query:
WITH RECURSIVE grp AS (
 /* Find TDS related groups */
 SELECT guid,name,_parent
 FROM mst_group
 WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%tds%'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT g.guid,g.name,g._parent
 FROM mst_group g
 JOIN grp p
 ON g._parent = p.guid
),
tds_entries AS (
 SELECT
 tv.guid,
 tv.date,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(tv.party_name,''),'Unknown') AS deductee_name,
 ml.name AS ledger_name,
 ta.amount
 FROM trn_accounting ta
 JOIN trn_voucher tv
 ON ta.guid = tv.guid
 JOIN mst_ledger ml
 ON ta._ledger = ml.guid
 LEFT JOIN grp
 ON ml._parent = grp.guid
 WHERE tv.date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
 AND (
 grp.guid IS NOT NULL
 OR LOWER(ml.name) LIKE '%tds%'
 OR LOWER(ml.name) LIKE '%194%'
 OR LOWER(ml.name) LIKE '%tax deducted%'
 )
),
summary AS (
 SELECT
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END),2) AS total_tds_deducted,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS total_tds_paid,
 ROUND(
 SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) -
 SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
 ,2) AS balance_payable,
 COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT deductee_name) AS deductee_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN deductee_name = 'Unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pan_missing_cases
 FROM tds_entries
)
SELECT
 'FY 2025-26' AS return_period,
 total_tds_deducted,
 total_tds_paid,
 balance_payable,
 transaction_count,
 deductee_count,
 pan_missing_cases,
 0 AS uncertain_transactions,
 0 AS late_fee
FROM summary;

question: What is my creditor aging?
query:
SELECT
 tv.date,
 vt.name AS voucher_type,
 tv.voucher_number,
 tv.party_name,
 tv.reference_number,
 dup.duplicate_count
FROM trn_voucher tv
JOIN mst_vouchertype vt
 ON tv._voucher_type = vt.guid
JOIN (
 /* Find document/reference numbers used in vouchers dated 02-02-2026,
 then check if same number exists multiple times in all dates */
 SELECT
 reference_number,
 COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
 FROM trn_voucher
 WHERE reference_number IN (
 SELECT DISTINCT reference_number
 FROM trn_voucher
 WHERE date = '2025-08-13'
 -- AND COALESCE(reference_number,'') <> ''
 )
 GROUP BY reference_number
 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) dup
 ON tv.reference_number = dup.reference_number
ORDER BY
 tv.reference_number,
 tv.date,
 tv.voucher_number;

question: Which cheques are pending clearance?
query:
WITH voucher_base AS (
 SELECT
 tv.guid,
 LOWER(mvt.name) AS voucher_type,
 -- correct alterid handling
 CASE
 WHEN tv.alterid IS NULL OR tv.alterid >= 1 THEN 0
 ELSE tv.alterid - 1
 END AS version_count,
 -- altered flag
 CASE
 WHEN tv.alterid > 1 THEN 1
 ELSE 0
 END AS is_altered
 FROM trn_voucher tv
 JOIN mst_vouchertype mvt
 ON tv._voucher_type = mvt.guid
 WHERE
 tv.date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
 -- 🚫 exclude migration (important)
 AND LOWER(COALESCE(tv.voucher_number, '')) NOT LIKE '%migration%'
 AND LOWER(COALESCE(tv.narration, '')) NOT LIKE '%migration%'
),
deleted_map AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT guid FROM _delete
)
SELECT
 vb.voucher_type,
 -- Altered (Deleted)
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN vb.is_altered = 1 THEN vb.guid END)
 || ' (' ||
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dm.guid IS NOT NULL THEN vb.guid END)
 || ')' AS "Altered (Deleted)",
 -- ✅ FIXED VERSION LOGIC
 SUM(vb.version_count) AS "Versions"
FROM voucher_base vb
LEFT JOIN deleted_map dm
 ON vb.guid = dm.guid
GROUP BY vb.voucher_type
ORDER BY SUM(vb.version_count) DESC;

question: Which invoices are due today?
query: WITH BillNetAmounts AS ( SELECT tb._ledger, tb.name AS bill_reference_name, SUM(tb.amount) AS net_bill_amount FROM trn_bill tb GROUP BY tb._ledger, tb.name HAVING SUM(tb.amount) > 0 ), BillOriginalDates AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (tb._ledger, tb.name) tb._ledger, tb.name AS bill_reference_name, tv.date AS original_bill_date FROM trn_bill tb JOIN trn_voucher tv ON tb.guid = tv.guid WHERE tb.billtype = 'New Ref' AND tv.is_order_voucher = 0 AND tv.is_inventory_voucher = 0 ORDER BY tb._ledger, tb.name, tv.date ASC ) SELECT ml.name AS creditor_name, SUM(CASE WHEN (DATE '2026-03-31' - bod.original_bill_date) <= 30 THEN bna.net_bill_amount ELSE 0 END) AS "0-30 Days", SUM(CASE WHEN (DATE '2026-03-31' - bod.original_bill_date) > 30 AND (DATE '2026-03-31' - bod.original_bill_date) <= 60 THEN bna.net_bill_amount ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 Days", SUM(CASE WHEN (DATE '2026-03-31' - bod.original_bill_date) > 60 AND (DATE '2026-03-31' - bod.original_bill_date) <= 90 THEN bna.net_bill_amount ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 Days", SUM(CASE WHEN (DATE '2026-03-31' - bod.original_bill_date) > 90 THEN bna.net_bill_amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Over 90 Days", SUM(bna.net_bill_amount) AS total_outstanding FROM BillNetAmounts bna JOIN BillOriginalDates bod ON bna._ledger = bod._ledger AND bna.bill_reference_name = bod.bill_reference_name JOIN mst_ledger ml ON bna._ledger = ml.guid JOIN mst_group mg ON ml._parent = mg.guid WHERE mg.primary_group = 'Sundry Creditors' GROUP BY ml.name ORDER BY ml.name;

question: Which customers delayed beyond 30 days?
query:
WITH contra_entries AS (
 SELECT
 tv.date,
 vt.name AS voucher_type,
 tv.voucher_number,
 /* Party / Bank ledger */
 COALESCE(NULLIF(tv.party_name,''),'Unknown') AS particulars,
 /* Tally display style */
 ROUND(SUM(
 CASE
 WHEN ta.amount > 0 THEN ta.amount
 ELSE 0
 END
 ),2) AS debit_amount,
 ROUND(SUM(
 CASE
 WHEN ta.amount < 0 THEN ABS(ta.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END
 ),2) AS credit_amount
 FROM trn_voucher tv
 JOIN mst_vouchertype vt
 ON tv._voucher_type = vt.guid
 JOIN trn_accounting ta
 ON ta.guid = tv.guid
 WHERE tv.date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
 AND LOWER(vt.name) LIKE '%contra%'
 GROUP BY
 tv.date,
 vt.name,
 tv.voucher_number,
 tv.party_name
)
SELECT
 date,
 particulars,
 voucher_type,
 voucher_number,
 debit_amount,
 credit_amount
FROM contra_entries
UNION ALL
SELECT
 NULL,
 'TOTAL',
 NULL,
 NULL,
 ROUND(SUM(debit_amount),2),
 ROUND(SUM(credit_amount),2)
FROM contra_entries
ORDER BY date NULLS LAST, voucher_number;

question: Any pending purchase orders?
query:
WITH today_vouchers AS (
 SELECT
 tv.guid,
 tv.date,
 tv.voucher_number,
 tv.party_name
 FROM trn_voucher tv
 WHERE tv.date >= '2025-04-01'
),
-- Discount Ledger Entries
ledger_discount AS (
 SELECT
 ta.guid,
 ml.name AS discount_ledger,
 CASE
 WHEN ta.amount < 0 THEN ABS(ta.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END AS debit_amount,
 CASE
 WHEN ta.amount > 0 THEN ta.amount
 ELSE 0
 END AS credit_amount
 FROM trn_accounting ta
 JOIN mst_ledger ml
 ON ta._ledger = ml.guid
 WHERE LOWER(ml.name) LIKE '%discount%'
)
SELECT
 tv.date,
 tv.voucher_number,
 tv.party_name,
 ld.discount_ledger,
 ld.debit_amount AS discount_given,
 ld.credit_amount AS discount_received
FROM today_vouchers tv
LEFT JOIN ledger_discount ld
 ON tv.guid = ld.guid
WHERE
 COALESCE(ld.debit_amount, 0) <> 0
 OR COALESCE(ld.credit_amount, 0) <> 0
ORDER BY tv.date, tv.voucher_number;

question: What expenses happened today?
query:
WITH purchase_data AS (
 SELECT
 ml.name AS supplier_name,
 si.name AS item_name,
 tv.date,
 ti.rate,
 LAG(ti.rate) OVER (
 PARTITION BY ml.guid, si.guid
 ORDER BY tv.date
 ) AS previous_rate
 FROM trn_inventory ti
 JOIN trn_voucher tv
 ON ti.guid = tv.guid
 JOIN mst_vouchertype vt
 ON tv._voucher_type = vt.guid
 JOIN mst_stock_item si
 ON ti._item = si.guid
 JOIN trn_accounting ta
 ON tv.guid = ta.guid
 JOIN mst_ledger ml
 ON ta._ledger = ml.guid
 JOIN mst_group mg
 ON ml._parent = mg.guid
 WHERE
 LOWER(vt.name) = 'purchase'
 AND ti.quantity > 0
 AND LOWER(mg.primary_group) = 'sundry creditors'
)
SELECT
 supplier_name,
 item_name,
 date,
 previous_rate,
 rate AS current_rate,
 (rate - previous_rate) AS increase_amount
FROM purchase_data
WHERE
 previous_rate IS NOT NULL
 AND rate > previous_rate
 AND item_name LIKE '%3M MASKING TAPE (24MM X 50MTR)%'
ORDER BY supplier_name, item_name, date;

question: Which bank transactions happened today?
query:
WITH petty_rows AS (
 SELECT
 tv.date,
 ml.name AS ledger_name,
 vt.name AS voucher_type,
 ta.amount
 FROM trn_accounting ta
 JOIN trn_voucher tv
 ON ta.guid = tv.guid
 JOIN mst_vouchertype vt
 ON tv._voucher_type = vt.guid
 JOIN mst_ledger ml
 ON ta._ledger = ml.guid
 WHERE tv.date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
 AND (
 LOWER(ml.name) LIKE '%petty cash%'
 OR LOWER(vt.name) LIKE '%petty cash%'
 )
),
daily AS (
 SELECT
 date,
 ROUND(SUM(
 CASE
 WHEN amount < 0 THEN ABS(amount)
 ELSE 0
 END
 ),2) AS debit,
 ROUND(SUM(
 CASE
 WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount
 ELSE 0
 END
 ),2) AS credit,
 SUM(amount) AS net_amt
 FROM petty_rows
 GROUP BY date
)
SELECT
 date,
 debit,
 credit,
 ROUND(
 SUM(net_amt) OVER (
 ORDER BY date
 ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
 ),2
 ) AS closing_balance
FROM daily
ORDER BY date;

 ELSE 0
 END AS amount

),

 due_date,
 amount

 ELSE 0

 party_name,
 ref_no
),

 -- Exclude fully settled bills

)

question: What is my stock turnover ratio?

WITH sales_comparison AS (
 SELECT
 /* Sales on 1 July 2020 */
 ABS(COALESCE(SUM(
 CASE
 WHEN tv.date = DATE '2024-06-07'
 AND mg.primary_group = 'Sales Accounts'
 THEN ta.amount
 ELSE 0
 END
 ), 0)) AS today_sales,

 ABS(COALESCE(SUM(

 AND DATE '2024-06-06'
 AND mg.primary_group = 'Sales Accounts'

 ), 0)) AS last_week_sales

 JOIN mst_group mg

)

 last_week_sales,

 ELSE (

 ) * 100
 END,
 2
 ) AS difference_percent
FROM sales_comparison;

WITH stock_values AS (
 SELECT

 THEN ti.amount

 ),

 ) AS debit_value,

 THEN -ti.quantity
 ELSE 0
 END
 ),
 0
 ) AS outward_qty,

 WHEN ti.quantity < 0
 THEN (-ti.quantity * ti.rate)
 ELSE 0
 END
 ),
 0
 ) AS gross_value
 FROM mst_stock_item msi

 ON ti._item = msi.guid
 GROUP BY

 msi.opening_value,
 msi.closing_value
),
profit_calc AS (
 SELECT
 stock_item,
 outward_qty,
 gross_value,
 ABS(
 opening_value
 + debit_value
 - closing_value
 ) AS consumption_value
 FROM stock_values
)
SELECT
 stock_item AS "Most Profitable Product",
 ROUND(outward_qty, 2) AS "Qty",
 ROUND(gross_value, 2) AS "Gross Value",
 ROUND(consumption_value, 2) AS "Consumption",
 ROUND(
 gross_value - consumption_value,
 2
 ) AS "Gross Profit",
 ROUND(
 CASE
 WHEN gross_value <> 0
 THEN (
 (gross_value - consumption_value)
 / gross_value
 ) * 100
 ELSE 0
 END,
 2
 ) AS "GP %"
FROM profit_calc
WHERE outward_qty > 0
ORDER BY
 "Gross Profit" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which item has highest return?
query:
WITH stock_values AS (
 SELECT
 msi.name AS stock_item,
 /* Opening Stock Value */
 COALESCE(ABS(msi.opening_value), 0) AS opening_value,
 /*
 Inward Value
 Include:
 - Purchase
 - Manufacturing
 - Stock Journal In
 - Debit Note
 Exclude:
 - Receipt Note
 - Purchase Order
 - Credit Note
 */
 COALESCE(
 SUM(
 CASE
 WHEN (
 ti.quantity > 0
 OR LOWER(tv.voucher_type) = 'debit note'
 )
 AND LOWER(tv.voucher_type) NOT IN (
 'receipt note',
 'purchase order',
 'credit note'
 )
 THEN ABS(ti.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END
 ),
 0
 ) AS inward_value,
 /* Closing Stock Value */
 COALESCE(ABS(msi.closing_value), 0) AS closing_value,
 /*
 Outward / Sales Value
 Include:
 - Sales
 - Credit Note
 - Any outward stock movement
 Exclude:
 - Sales Order
 - Purchase Order
 */
 COALESCE(
 SUM(
 CASE
 WHEN (
 ti.quantity < 0
 OR LOWER(tv.voucher_type) = 'credit note'
 )
 AND LOWER(tv.voucher_type) NOT IN (
 'sales order',
 'purchase order'
 )
 THEN ABS(ti.amount)
 ELSE 0
 END
 ),
 0
 ) AS outward_value
 FROM mst_stock_item msi
 LEFT JOIN trn_inventory ti
 ON ti._item = msi.guid
 LEFT JOIN trn_voucher tv
 ON tv.guid = ti.guid
 GROUP BY
 msi.name,
 msi.opening_value,
 msi.closing_value
),
profit_calc AS (
 SELECT
 stock_item,
 opening_value,
 inward_value,
 outward_value,
 closing_value,
 outward_value AS gross_value,
 /*
 Consumption Formula:
 Opening + Inward - Closing
 */
 (
 opening_value
 + inward_value
 - closing_value
 ) AS consumption_value,
 /*
 Gross Profit Formula:
 Sales - Consumption
 */
 (
 outward_value
 -
 (
 opening_value
 + inward_value
 - closing_value
 )
 ) AS gross_profit
 FROM stock_values
)
SELECT
 stock_item AS "Least Profitable Product",
 ROUND(opening_value, 2) AS "Opening Value",
 ROUND(inward_value, 2) AS "Inward Value",
 ROUND(outward_value, 2) AS "Outward Value",
 ROUND(closing_value, 2) AS "Closing Value",
 ROUND(gross_value, 2) AS "Gross Value",
 ROUND(consumption_value, 2) AS "Consumption",
 ROUND(gross_profit, 2) AS "Gross Profit",
 ROUND(
 CASE
 WHEN gross_value <> 0
 THEN (gross_profit / gross_value) * 100
 ELSE 0
 END,
 2
 ) AS "GP %"
FROM profit_calc
/*
 Lowest GP % first
*/
ORDER BY
 "GP %" ASC,
 gross_profit ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which item has highest demand?
query:
WITH stock_ageing AS (
 SELECT
 msi.name AS stock_item,
 /*
 Absolute Closing Stock Quantity
 */
 ABS(
 COALESCE(msi.closing_balance, 0)
 ) AS closing_stock_qty,
 /*
 Latest stock movement date
 considering BOTH inward and outward
 */
 MAX(tv.date) AS last_stock_movement_date
 FROM mst_stock_item msi
 LEFT JOIN trn_inventory ti
 ON ti._item = msi.guid
 LEFT JOIN trn_voucher tv
 ON tv.guid = ti.guid
 GROUP BY
 msi.name,
 msi.closing_balance
)
SELECT
 stock_item,
 last_stock_movement_date,
 /*
 Stock ageing days
 */
 CASE
 WHEN last_stock_movement_date IS NULL THEN 0
 ELSE DATE '2021-02-13'::date
 -
 last_stock_movement_date::date
 END AS ageing_days,
 ROUND(
 closing_stock_qty::numeric,
 2
 ) AS stock_qty
FROM stock_ageing
/*
 Remove zero quantity stock
*/
WHERE closing_stock_qty <> 0
/*
 Highest ageing first,
 then highest quantity
*/
ORDER BY
 ageing_days DESC,
 closing_stock_qty DESC
 limit 1;

question: Which stock is older than 90 days?
query:
WITH sales AS (
 SELECT
 ti._item,
 si.name,
 /*
 Total outward quantity
 */
 SUM(
 ABS(
 COALESCE(ti.quantity, 0)
 )
 ) AS demand_qty,
 /*
 Total outward value
 */
 SUM(
 ABS(
 COALESCE(ti.amount, 0)
 )
 ) AS demand_value
 FROM trn_inventory ti
 INNER JOIN trn_voucher tv
 ON ti.guid = tv.guid
 INNER JOIN mst_vouchertype vt
 ON tv._voucher_type = vt.guid
 INNER JOIN mst_stock_item si
 ON ti._item = si.guid
 WHERE
 /*
 Only outward stock movement
 */
 ti.quantity < 0
 /*
 Only selected voucher types
 */
 AND LOWER(vt.name) IN (
 LOWER('Delivery Note'),
 LOWER('Sales'),
 LOWER('Rejections Out'),
 LOWER('Stock Journal')
 )
 /*
 Date range
 */
 AND tv.date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01'
 AND DATE '2026-03-31'
 GROUP BY
 ti._item,
 si.name
)
SELECT
 name AS product_name,
 ROUND(demand_qty::numeric, 2) AS demand_qty,
 ROUND(demand_value::numeric, 2) AS demand_value
FROM sales
ORDER BY demand_qty DESC
 limit 1;
